label: Early Childhood-Onset Prosopometamorphopsia Following Respiratory Tract Infection With Serological Evidence of Mycoplasma pneumoniae Exposure: A Pediatric Case Report.
summary: We report a pediatric case of prosopometamorphopsia (PMO), a rare disorder characterized by distorted face perception. Following a respiratory tract infection at four years of age, the male patient began to perceive visual distortions in human faces. His developmental and medical histories were unremarkable.
